sources.title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025

clauses.reference: Key Fact Statement (paragraph to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: The borrower receives a Key Fact Statement in a standard format before executing the loan contract.

clauses.reference: Annual Percentage Rate disclosure (paragraph to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: The all-inclusive cost of the loan is disclosed as an Annual Percentage Rate, together with tenor and repayment terms.

clauses.reference: Data storage (paragraph to be confirmed by counsel)
clauses.summary: Borrower data collected for digital lending is stored on servers located in India.

rules.title: Key Fact Statement acknowledged before the contract
rules.pass_detail: The borrower acknowledged the Key Fact Statement before signing.
rules.fail_detail: The Key Fact Statement has not been acknowledged by the borrower.

rules.title: Loan offer shows APR, tenor and repayment terms
rules.pass_detail: APR, number of instalments and instalment amount are disclosed.
rules.fail_detail: The offer is missing the APR, tenor or repayment amount.

rules.title: Borrower data stored in India
rules.pass_detail: Case data is stored in an Indian cloud region.
rules.fail_detail: Case data is not stored in an Indian region. Deploy an India instance before lending in India.
